scope: Real temporary filesystem and separate Node restart process; no production data.

cases.expected: Same task/owner/project create is idempotent; changed owner is rejected.
Mutating input, returned task or nested event payload cannot change stored data.
Interleaved task events receive global seq 1,2,3; per-task cursor after1 returns only3.
A separately started Node process reads event1 and appends event2.
Broken JSON is rejected without replacing original bytes.
Changing an owner in otherwise valid JSON fails checksum validation.
Unsupported schema cannot be encoded or replace current schema1 data.
NaN, functions, prototype keys and oversized payloads append zero events.
A second writer is rejected until the first closes.
Injected pre-rename failure preserves the committed snapshot and removes temporary output.
Snapshot and lock permission modes equal0600.
Unknown task and path-like identity requests cannot mutate state.
